title: The Bremen Town Musicians
text:
A donkey had worked for his master for many years, but now he was old and weak, and he learned that his master meant to get rid of him. So he ran away and set off for the city of Bremen, where he thought he could become a town musician.

On the road he met an old hunting dog whose master was going to kill him because he could no longer hunt. Then a cat who was going to be drowned because she could no longer catch mice. Then a rooster crowing his heart out because he was going to be made into soup. To each the donkey said: come with us to Bremen, you will find something better than death.

That night, in the forest, they saw a lit house. Inside a band of robbers sat at a table full of food. The animals made a plan. The donkey put his front hooves on the window sill, the dog jumped on his back, the cat climbed on the dog, and the rooster perched on the cat. Then all four made their music at once: braying, barking, meowing and crowing. They crashed through the window, and the terrified robbers fled into the woods.

When one robber crept back in the dark, the cat scratched him, the dog bit him, the donkey kicked him, and the rooster screamed. The robbers never returned, and the four friends liked the house so much that they stayed there.
lesson: People the world has written off can still be formidable together. Combine what each one has left, and use it at the same moment.
people: A donkey, a dog, a cat, a rooster, robbers
source: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm, Kinder- und Hausmarchen, No. 27, The Bremen Town Musicians
